defs.def: the solid surface of the earth 地；地面

ex.s: The frozen solid ground actually contains bits of rock, mineral and organic matter, leaving spaces in between.
ex.t: 冻得坚硬的地面实际上包含岩石、矿物和有机物的微粒，在它们之间留下了空隙。

ex.s: Why is the frozen Arctic ground hard for water to get through?
ex.t: 为什么冻结的北极地面坚硬，水难以渗入？

ex.s: The fascinating part of the study for robotics is that elephants can use air suction both on ground and in water.
ex.t: 这项研究对机器人技术来说最迷人的部分是大象可以在地面和水中都使用空气吸力。

ex.s: To improve the ground service for e-planes.
ex.t: 为了改善电动飞机的地面服务。

ex.s: Baggy has become the first dog in the UK—and potentially the world—to join the fight against air pollution by recording pollutant levels near the ground.
ex.t: 它的监测器显示，越接近地面，空气污染程度越高，这突显了一个令人担忧的问题：婴儿和幼儿患肺部疾病的风险可能更高。

ex.s: On the ground, it gets 35 miles per gallon.
ex.t: 在地面行驶时，每加仑可行驶35英里。

ex.s: On the ground, it gets 35 miles per gallon.
ex.t: 在地面行驶时，每加仑可行驶35英里。

ex.s: It is also said that mice and snakes head for safer ground several days before an earthquake, while dogs avoiding the beach may be a sign that a tsunami is approaching.
ex.t: 还有人说，老鼠和蛇会在地震前几天逃往更安全的地方，而狗避开海滩可能是海啸即将来临的征兆。

ex.s: “In fact, we may be helping increase the moisture downwind by creating wetter ground.”
ex.t: 事实上，我们可能正在通过制造更湿润的地面来帮助增加下风向的湿度。

ex.s: The rainfall carries heat into the ground.
ex.t: 降雨将热量带入地下。

ex.s: Baggy wears a pollution monitor on her collar so she can take data measurements close to the ground.
ex.t: 巴吉的衣领上戴着一个污染监测器，这样她就能在贴近地面的地方采集数据。

ex.s: Air is more polluted closer to the ground.
ex.t: 离地面越近，空气受到的污染越严重。

ex.s: Then nine days laters, a fire burned the  51  to the ground.
ex.t: 九天后，一场大火把____烧为平地。

ex.s: The ground floor of the forest is not all tangled leaves and bushes, like in films, but is actually fairly clear.
ex.t: 森林的地面并不像电影里那样全是纠缠不清的树叶和灌木，而是实际上相当开阔。

ex.s: And while plastic bags may be ugly to look at, they represent a small percentage of all garbage on the ground today.z.x.xk
ex.t: 而且尽管塑料袋看着可能丑，但它们只占如今地面所有垃圾的很小比例。z.x.xk

ex.s: The English youngster noticed that pollution levels are around two-thirds higher close to the ground than they are in the air at the height where they are recorded by the agency.
ex.t: 这位英国少年注意到，靠近地面的污染水平约为地面高度三分之二，而该高度的数据是由该机构记录的。

ex.s: I’m telling you, my happy feet barely touched the ground all the way home.
ex.t: 我跟你说，我快乐的脚几乎没碰到地面，一路走回家。

ex.s: According to her research, runners hit the ground with as much as four times their body weight per step, while race walkers, who do not leave the ground, create only about 1.4 times their body weight with each step.
ex.t: 根据她的研究，跑步者每步落地时对地面的冲击力可达体重的四倍，而竞走者不离开地面，每步只产生约1.4倍体重的冲击。

ex.s: It has allowed China to accomplish in just four decades what took Western industrialised countries more than 200 years to achieve, breaking new ground in the history of human achievement.
ex.t: 它使中国在短短40年内完成了西方工业化国家200多年来取得的成就，开创了人类成就史上的新天地。

ex.s: Suddenly, Paris fell to the ground, “Paris’s eye rolled back,” Taylor says.
ex.t: 突然，帕里斯倒在地上，“帕里斯的眼睛翻了过去，”泰勒说。

ex.s: Galileo was not merely ambitious when he dropped objects of varying weights from the Leaning Tower at Pisa and timed their fall to the ground.
ex.t: 伽利略并非只是好高骛远，当他从比萨斜塔扔下重量不同的物体并计时它们落地时。

ex.s: In the case of emperors, the act required the person to touch their head to the ground.
ex.t: 在皇帝的情况下，该礼节要求人把头触地。

ex.s: Her monitor has shown that air pollution levels are higher closer to ground level, which has helped highlight concerns that babies and young kids may be at higher risk of developing lung problems.
ex.t: 她的监测器显示，越靠近地面，空气污染水平越高，这凸显了人们对婴儿和幼儿可能面临更高患肺病风险的担忧。

defs.def: soil on the surface of the earth 土；土地；土壤

ex.s: The chemical washes off roads and goes into the ground.
ex.t: 在那里它可以污染饮用水、损害植物、侵蚀土壤。

ex.s: D Because snow rarely melts on frozen ground.
ex.t: D 因为雪在冻土上很少融化。

defs.def: an area of open land 开阔地；空旷地
an area of land that is used for a particular purpose, activity or sport 常构成复合词

ex.s: Moore then used her savings to get her business of the ground.
ex.t: 得到父亲的许可后，她花了两年时间在网上进行研究并进行试验，终于得到了既美味又护齿的配方。

defs.def: a large area of land or sea that is used for a particular purpose （某种用途的）地域，水域
the land or gardens around a large building （大建筑物周围的）场地，庭院，花园

ex.s: In a matrix garden, plants with similar cultural needs are grouped so that they will grow together above and below ground, forming a cooperative ecosystem that conserves water and discourages weeds.
ex.t: 在矩阵花园中，养护需求相似的植物被组合在一起，使它们在地上地下共同生长，形成一个节约用水、抑制杂草的协作生态系统。

ex.s: The pressures of "time" and "destination" are further blocks to awareness． I encountered many hikers who were headed to a distant camp﹣ground with just enough time to get there before dark． It seldom occurred to them to wander a bit， to take a moment to see what's around them． I asked them what they'd seen． "Oh， a few birds， "they said． They seemed bent on their destinations．
ex.t: 时间和'目的地'的压力是觉悟的进一步障碍。我遇到许多徒步者，他们赶往一个遥远的营地，刚好有足够时间在天黑前到达。他们很少想到要闲逛一会儿，花点时间看看周围有什么。我问他们看到了什么。'哦，几只鸟，'他们说。他们似乎一心奔着目的地。

ex.s: Come and work out with our qualified personal trainer, Jodie McGregor, on the grounds of the Middleton Lodge estate.
ex.t: 来和我们的合格私人教练乔迪·麦格雷戈一起，在米德尔顿洛奇庄园的场地上锻炼吧。

defs.def: an area of interest, knowledge or ideas （兴趣、知识或思想的）范围，领域

ex.s: The thief drops to the ground.
ex.t: 他拿出一个特殊设备，对准嫌疑人，打开开关。

defs.def: a good or true reason for saying, doing or believing sth 充分的理由；根据
the small pieces of solid matter in a liquid that have fallen to the bottom 渣滓；沉淀物
a wire that connects an electric circuit with the ground and makes it safe （接）地线

ex.s: One of the ground rules of the swap should be that everyone must try on the clothes before they take them—things always look different when you put them on.
ex.t: 衣物交换的基本规则之一应该是：每个人在拿走衣服之前必须试穿——衣服穿在身上看起来总是不一样的。

ex.s: The doorway to peace and quiet, for Nick Bright at least, leads straight to his mother-in-law, she lives on the ground floor, while he lives upstairs with his wife and their two daughters.
ex.t: 对于Nick Bright来说，通往宁静的入口直通他岳母那里，她住在一楼，而他楼上和妻子及两个女儿住在一起。

ex.s: They share a front door and a washing machine, but Rita Whitehead has her own kitchen, bathroom, bedroom and living room on the ground floor.
ex.t: 他们共用一扇大门和一台洗衣机，但丽塔·怀特黑德在一楼有自己独立的厨房、浴室、卧室和起居室。

ex.s: When I was looking for the exit, I saw that shoes were actually sold downstairs on the ground floor, not the first floor.
ex.t: 我找出口时，发现鞋其实是在底层楼下卖，不是在一楼。

defs.def: a background that a design is painted or printed on （绘画或印刷的）背景，底子

ex.s: Background information In Britain, the floor of a building at the bottom level is called the "ground floor" and the floor above it is called the "first floor".
ex.t: 背景信息：在英国，大楼最底层的楼面被称为"ground floor"，它上面一层被称为"first floor"。

defs.def: to continue with your opinions or intentions when sb is opposing you and wants you to change 坚持主张；坚持意图；坚持立场；不让步
to face a situation and refuse to run away 坚守阵地；不撤退；不退却
when a boat grounds or sth grounds it, it touches the bottom of the sea and is unable to move （使）搁浅，触海底

ex.s: Who mainly uses the ground floor in the Victorian house in Bristol?
ex.t: 谁主要使用布里斯托尔维多利亚式房子的一楼？

ex.s: History grounds us in our roots.
ex.t: 历史让我们扎根于我们的根源。

defs.def: to prevent an aircraft from taking off 使停飞；阻止 … 起飞
to punish a child or young person by not allowing them to go out with their friends for a period of time 罚（儿童）不准出去玩

ex.s: Meimei @meimei01 8 Nov Check out the ground-breaking installations.
ex.t: 梅梅：查看那些开创性的装置艺术。

defs.def: to make electrical equipment safe by connecting it to the ground with a wire 把（电器）接地线
